brands.ja: SD ガンダム BB戦士

description.ja: • 「SD ガンダム三国伝　Brave Battle Warriors」に登場する新武将をキット化。
description.en: • New warlords appearing in "SD Gundam Sangokuden Brave Battle Warriors" are now available as kits.

description.ja: • 専用の両刃の鎌（分解すると双剣になる）を装備。
description.en: • Equipped with a special double-edged sickle (which becomes a twin sword when disassembled).

description.ja: • 背中に「暗黒ブースター（仮称）」と両肩に武器「暗黒瘴気ポッド（仮称）」を装備。
description.en: • Equipped with a "dark booster (tentative name)" on its back and a weapon " dark miasma pod (tentative name)" on both shoulders.

description.ja: • ブースターとポッド合体して台座になる。
description.en: • The booster and pod combine to form a pedestal.

description.ja: • 足裏の印鑑モールドは「袁術」。
description.en: • The seal mold on the sole of the foot is "Yuan Shu".

description.ja: 成形品×4、シール×1、取説マンガ有り
description.en: Molded product x 4, Seal x 1, instruction manual manga included
